column1: # Snapshot of production `supabase_migrations.schema_migrations` — taken 2026-08-24, BEFORE the
# ledger repair and BEFORE `perf_advisors` was applied. 73 rows, the complete prior state.
# ⚠️ THIS IS NOT A DATABASE BACKUP. It is bookkeeping only: no user data, no schema objects,
# nothing that cascades. It exists so the exact prior state of the ledger can be restored by hand
# if the repair goes wrong. The children's data still has NO backup and no PITR — see
# docs/launch-plan.md (launch blocker) and docs/schema-baseline-debt.md.
# Columns:
#   version   the ledger key. `supabase db push` compares local filename versions against these.
#   name      informational only; push does not match on it.
#   sql_md5   md5(array_to_string(statements, E'\n'))              — the applied SQL, verbatim.
#   norm_md5  md5 of the same text with `--` comments and ALL whitespace stripped. This is what
#             pairs a ledger row to a repo file: the CLI strips leading comments when it stores a
#             migration, so a raw hash does not compare and a NAME comparison is a guess.
# Regenerate / verify with:
#   select version, name,
#          md5(array_to_string(statements, E'\n')) as sql_md5,
#          md5(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(array_to_string(statements, E'\n'),
#   from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations order by version;
version
